title: Secret Universe
creator: vocational

blocks.v:
Most of the puzzles are highly creative and entertaining; however, the hints for some of them are extremely difficult to spot.
This game has been revolutionary for the "puzzle" genre on Roblox, and the majority of popular puzzle games currently available draw their inspiration from it.

title: Operation: Secrets

title: Deserted Secrets
creator: Deserted Secrets
verdict: A high-quality game that almost no one plays

blocks.v:
Among puzzle games, this title stands out for its superior map design and visual effects.
Some of the puzzles are extremely difficult, even though there are only 35 badges to collect.
Sadly, almost no one plays this game.

title: somewhat stupid secrets
creator: Pseudonymous Games
verdict: You need to think in very non-linear ways to figure out some of the puzzles

blocks.v:
The game is highly creative; solving some of the puzzles requires a significant amount of lateral thinking. There is no denying that it is a very fun and entertaining experience.
It features a nostalgic style, though elements like the jumping sound effects and the segmented camera zooming feel like they belong to different eras.
The head animations are a bit distracting—but that’s not a big deal.

title: Tycoon Secrets
creator: [Nil Creations]

blocks.v:
The game requires a remarkably broad range of knowledge, including familiarity with HTML.
It is extremely difficult and not recommended for those with absolutely no prior experience or those unfamiliar with puzzle games.
The game consistently finds unexpected ways to hide code; the rush of dopamine you get upon cracking a new piece of code is incredibly addictive.

title: Anything Can Be A Secret
creator: acbas

blocks.v:
A rather popular puzzle game.
You might just wander around a bit and suddenly unlock a badge; compared to other games, most badges here are actually quite easy to obtain. As the title suggests, anything could be a secret.
The game incorporates items from various other titles (for instance, the trophy from *Easiest Game Ever!*). I was actually quite surprised to come across these...
